# Multiable aiM18 HCM | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Multinational Asia-Pacific HR and Pay | The main link for validation of HR and remuneration in Asia and the Pacific is “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Retail/manufacturing groups | The main link to verify retail/manufacturing groups is “entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - self-help of staff managers - results into reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| HR and Finance ERP integration | The integration of HR and financial ERP is validated on the main link with “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Complex approval and reporting | • Validation of complex approvals and statements on the main link with “person or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
